decision.instructions: Which colour did the pointer stop on? Assess only the supplied information.

criteria.BLUE: The pointer stopped on the blue sector.
criteria.GREEN: The pointer stopped on the green sector.
criteria.RED: The pointer stopped on the red sector.

state.scenario: A fair spinner with three equal-sized sectors, coloured red, green and blue, was spun and stopped out of view. Nobody observed the result. There are no other clues.
